title: 25:3 strong people glorify thee. This refers to the Lord's righteous people (Job 17:9), both the house of Israel (Gen. 25:23) and the Gentiles who serve the Lord. In the last days, they will glorify (praise) the name of the Lord because of his mighty work of cleansing the earth of the wicked and redeeming the righteous.
author: Tina M. Peterson
